public_task.contract: Return True exactly when authenticated is True and either role is the exact string 'admin' or owns_resource is True. All other requests must return False. Role comparisons are case-sensitive; ownership does not replace authentication.

language.body: Exactly one return statement whose evaluated result is a bool.
language.expressions: True, False, None, nonnegative integer literals, string literals; request['known_field']; and, or, not; ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=; in and not in with a literal list or tuple of scalar constants. Parentheses and chained comparisons are allowed. Boolean operators use Python short-circuit semantics. No other Python syntax is allowed.
language.restrictions: One function only; no imports, calls, attributes, defaults, annotations, decorators, extra statements, arbitrary names, or nested containers. Request fields and types are specified by each task. All requests contain all named fields. The return value must be exactly bool, not an integer.
